title: 第15章 化妖第16章 都统大人丰田县城我帮你守
slug: 骂我朝廷鹰犬我乃大秦武圣
content_zh:
云隐山岚，看似刀法轻灵，其实云雾之间，山岳厚重。
刀锋席卷之间，三位先天境尽被这一刀所迫，不得不退后一步。
一株阻在刀锋之前的两尺围树干应声而断。
这一刀要是斩在谁的身上，必然是一刀两断的下场。
云隐山岚才动，第二招峰回路转已经斩出。
长刀往左侧一带，刀锋追着那身穿黑甲的中年而去，中途又是刀光一变，翻身斩在另外一位来救援的先天境长枪上。
“当——”
那位先天境退后一步，手中长枪震动。
“杀——”
余林一刀得手，脚步后转，借腰力挥刀，刀锋仿若匹练。
他手上的刀不是张远那种腰刀，而是刀锋狭长，刀柄五尺的沙场战刀。
双手持刀，刀光层叠无尽。
刀气！
先天真元与纯熟刀法相合，一身真元可达刀锋之上，是为刀气。
刀气看似薄薄流光，却透着难以想象的锋利，无法承载的厚重。
能将真元灌注刀剑兵器，凝聚刀气剑器，才是先天境之中的真正强者。
“轰——”
一刀斩落，那败退的燕军先天境手中长枪挡不住，应声断裂。
其身躯也被一刀斩飞，撞在后方树干上，口中吐血。
余林长笑，刀随敌身，再斩而出。

岳岚叠翠。
江河奔腾。
山川迢迢。
飞瀑流泉。
碧水绕峰。
……
余林的刀不离那位被他一刀斩退的先天境，浑然不顾身后其他两人解围。
“生死搏杀，还敢分神，就是自寻死路！”
“真的当自己多厉害，还将老夫当成垫脚石。”
“杀——”
余林的声音之中透出张狂。
张远知道，余林是在告诫自己，生死搏杀之间，需要全力以赴。
同时，也是告诉他，余林会在关键时候出手，帮他和段宏争取逃命的机会。
握紧刀柄，咬紧牙关，张远微微低头，只用余光去看前方的拼杀。
他的脑海之中，持刀黑甲虚影动作不断流转。
原来余林对这套山岳刀法也只是领悟到大成层次。
世间修行，武技战法想修到大圆满，那是需要真正的天赋和机缘的。
功法大成，基本上就是世间修行者的极限。
“杀——”
余林长刀陡然横斩，将手中握着断枪的中年先天境身躯斩飞出七八丈外，跌落在地，口中吐血。

他身后，欧阳公子一剑刺在他后背肩甲上，剑锋穿透左肩，鲜血淋漓。
“滚——”
余林一声怒吼，长刀倒转，一刀斩断欧阳公子手中剑，将其身躯撞开。
content_en:
The mountains are hidden in the clouds, and it seems that the swordsmanship is light and agile, but in fact, the mountains are thick and thick between the clouds and mist.
As the blade swept across, the three Xiantian realms were forced by the blade and had to take a step back.
A two-foot-long tree trunk in front of the blade was snapped.
If this knife hits anyone, it will definitely end in two pieces.
Yunyin Shanlan had just moved, and the second move, "Turning the Wind", had already been executed.
The long sword moved to the left, and the blade chased the middle-aged man in black armor. The sword's light changed midway, and he turned over and slashed at another Xiantian realm spear who came to the rescue.
"When——"
The Xiantian realm took a step back, the spear in his hand vibrating.
"Kill——"
Yu Lin succeeded with the sword, turned his steps back, and used his waist strength to swing the sword. The blade was as sharp as a sword.
The knife in his hand is not Zhang Yuan's waist knife, but a battlefield knife with a long and narrow blade and a five-foot handle.
Holding the knife in both hands, the sword light is endless.
Knife Qi!
The innate true energy is combined with the proficient sword skills, and the true energy of the body can reach the blade, which is the sword energy.
The sword energy seems to be thin and flowing, but it is unimaginably sharp and unbearably heavy.
Those who can infuse true energy into swords and weapons and condense sword energy into swords and weapons are the truly strong ones in the innate realm.
"Boom——"
With a slash of the sword, the spear in the hands of the retreating Yan Jun's Xiantian Realm could not be blocked and broke with a sound.
His body was also chopped off with a knife, and he hit the tree trunk behind him, vomiting blood from his mouth.
Yu Lin smiled, followed the enemy with his sword, and then slashed out.
Yuelan is verdant.
Rivers surge.
The mountains and rivers are far away.
Waterfalls and springs.
Green water surrounds the peak.
…
Yu Lin's sword could not leave the Xiantian who was driven back by his sword, and he did not care about the other two people behind him to save the siege.
"If you dare to be distracted during a life-and-death fight, you are seeking your own death!"
"You really think you are so powerful, and you still use me as a stepping stone."
"Kill——"
There was arrogance in Yu Lin's voice.
Zhang Yuan knew that Yu Lin was warning him that he needed to go all out in the fight between life and death.
At the same time, he also told him that Yu Lin would take action at a critical moment to help him and Duan Hong gain a chance to escape.
Holding the handle of the knife tightly and gritting his teeth, Zhang Yuan lowered his head slightly and only used his peripheral vision to look at the fighting ahead.
In his mind, the movements of the phantom holding a knife and black armor kept flowing.
It turns out that Yu Lin only understood the mountain sword technique at the Dacheng level.
If you want to practice martial arts and warfare to perfection in this world, you need real talent and opportunity.
The mastery of the technique is basically the limit for practitioners in this world.
"Kill——"
Yu Lin's long sword suddenly slashed horizontally, and the middle-aged Xiantian state body holding the broken spear in his hand flew seven or eight feet away, falling to the ground, vomiting blood from his mouth.
Behind him, Young Master Ouyang stabbed his shoulder on the back with a sword. The sword edge penetrated his left shoulder, drawing blood.
"Go away——"
Yu Lin roared angrily, reversed his sword, cut off the sword in Master Ouyang's hand, and knocked his body away.
